input.command:
python3 -c "
import cv2, numpy as np

img28 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0028.png')
# Chair on the right:
mask_chair = (img28[:,:,2] > 80) & (img28[:,:,2] < 150) & (img28[:,:,1] > 35) & (img28[:,:,1] < 80) & (img28[:,:,0] < 50) & (np.arange(512)[None,:] > 460)
ys, xs = np.where(mask_chair)
print('Chair 1 in obs 28: x in [', xs.min(), xs.max(), '], y in [', ys.min(), ys.max(), '], bottom y =', ys.max())
d_c1 = 256 * 1.55 / (ys.max() - 255.5)
print(f'Chair 1 dist: {d_c1:.2f}')
x_c1 = -0.5 - d_c1
y_c1 = 3.3 + (xs.mean() - 255.5)/256 * d_c1
print(f'Chair 1 coords: x = {x_c1:.2f}, y = {y_c1:.2f}')
"
